# DS #352 — Original-device / native-handoff proof for machine-key enrollment

**Security objective:** a valid Agent bearer token alone MUST NOT enroll a machine key. Authenticated DS session, exact original consumed device-code or native-handoff secret, matching account/user/session/device, and real EdDSA or ES256 key PoP are all required. On PENDING enrollment retry, preserve identical canonical SPKI/thumbprint/keyAlgorithm; burn old nonce. ACTIVE/REVOKED registration cannot rotate or silently overwrite.

**Source ancestry:** DS #350 actual disposable TLS+Postgres cross-process proof, after source merge; DS #346 independent default-off `AGENT_KEY_HTTP_ENABLED` and unconditional production 404 retained unchanged through #348 and #350. This #352 delta adds **`device_code`** as strict 43-character input in ENROLL, cryptographically hashes it with server pepper, verifies exact consumed `AgentDeviceAuthorization` row and joins authenticated session/device/account/user before any persistent key registration. A stolen bearer without original device/handoff proof must fail closed.

**Real certification:** disposable PostgreSQL token/session/device provenance positive/negative tests; two actual separately authenticated test .NET processes through real local TLS Next POST handlers, EdDSA DEVICE_CODE and ES256 NATIVE_HANDOFF, each pinned to immutable Agent source `8135b6673bd6800bd0d30e29b623439a43bac6d3` (GitHub confirms Agent #126 head ancestor of current Agent main). Synthetic test-only software keys do NOT demonstrate physical TPM. The harness explicitly configures `AGENT_ACCOUNT_SESSION_ENABLED=true` and `AGENT_KEY_HTTP_ENABLED=true` with `DEPLOYMENT_ENV=test` and removes independent test flag on teardown; production branch remains categorically denied.

**Minimum complete exact-head graph:** `pr core licensing native-account identity prisma-isolation` (six owners); CORE owns disposable DB, migration, actual separate-process TLS tests and application/Workers/workerd/container proof; licensing owns cryptographic machine-proof authority, native/identity session/auth context; Prisma isolation owns stored authorization linkage. Platform configuration unchanged (gate from #346), still asserted by PR source tests, not separately rerun. Entitlement/catalog/payment/commerce/PayMongo/Resend/installer/VM/UTM/production signing/release NOT required.

**Cross-repo:** Agent #126 original device/handoff source certified independently `contracts windows-x64` at exact `8135b6673bd6800bd0d30e29b623439a43bac6d3` and is ancestor of Agent main `2a697fc03c96130348888f1d941fc684a210344a`. Source-only DS runtime test does not prove installed Agent binaries, physical TPM, production Cloudflare instance or signed product JWS.

**Current status:** awaiting source reconciliation onto merged DS #350 and fresh exact-head 6/6 certification before SHA-locked source-only merge. No real production deployment, key enrollment/issuer signing, production DB, money/email, JWS package, catalog/installer publication, or force push.
